item.title: Wayve raises US$1.5bil for robotaxi wars
item.description: LONDON: Wayve, the UK autonomous driving software startup, has raised US$1.5 billion (RM5.84bil) in funding at an US$8.6 billion (RM33.5bil) valuation as it prepares to go up against Chinese and US rivals to roll out self-driving taxis. item.title: Aston Martin slashes staff as US tariffs hit
item.description: LONDON: British luxury carmaker Aston Martin has announced plans to cut up to 20 percent of its workforce after widening annual losses on United States tariffs and weak Chinese demand.
